description:
Crawl a site's sitemap and check every page

Audits every page a sitemap lists rather than only the homepage, and groups what it finds by the thing that has to change. Reports the checks that passed and the ones that did not apply, so a missing finding cannot be mistaken for a passing one. The crawl runs on your machine: it fetches the site you point it at, and your audit results are never sent to the publisher. Features you turn on yourself contact Google PageSpeed Insights and Search Console, and the app checks GitHub for new versions.
